attBesluta.text: Es hermoso. El montaje es fácil, pero las instrucciones no están del todo bien, por momentos tienes que adivinar dónde van las piezas pero con lógica se puede hacer sin problema. El material es excelente. Y el producto se ve tal cual las fotos de la publicación.
I am very satisfied with this table. It is stylish and easy to maneuver around. Definitely worth the cost.
Molto facile da montare, giuste dimensioni come descritto. Leggero ma robusto. Lo consiglio
Easy to assemble. Works great for the guest room side table.

This cart is awesome! I was hesitant to purchase anything from this company, but the quality of this product has convinced me that I'm going to be shopping more on their site. The cart is a great solution when you are trying to keep everything efficiently stored, but also need a work surface/tool cart for the house. This cart is even sturdy enough that it could easily be used in the garage. The 360 wheels are so smooth, and it is very easy to unfold/fold. Highly recommend!
This is a great a work cart. Folds up easily to store in small spaces.

I am a maintenance mechanic and I service restaurants. This cart is awesome. I bought the smaller version a while back but it was to small. This cart is full size and folds so I can put it sideways in my service van. Great for bring in tools, parts and small equipment in one shot into the kitchen. Well worth the $$$
Everything is fine. Strong and handy. I just want bigger wheels to go over some debris

Sturdy and convenient, one complaint about the aluminium legs is that they have sort of plastic wrap on them and one was peeling from the top so now I have to take it apart so I can peel it all off so it looks nice.
Very sturdy. Easy to assemble and lots of storage space.
Mooi goede stevige degelijke schoonmaak kar, Alles kun je er opzetten. Makkelijk te rijden, en je kunt alles in een keer meenemen wat je nodig bent, niet meer heen en weer lopen naar je werkkast.
Bon rapport qualité prix, facile à monter avec la notice détaillée. Satisfait de ce premier achat Vevor
